source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text:
As in other MAFF-published banana guidance, this booklet recommends drip irrigation over conventional flood or furrow watering, citing water savings of roughly 30 to 65 percent for the same crop performance. Drip lines are laid along each row so water is delivered directly to the root zone at the base of each plant.

Besides saving water, drip irrigation keeps the foliage and stem surface drier than overhead or flood methods, which helps reduce the humid conditions that favor fungal leaf diseases such as Sigatoka leaf spot.
